description: This Java class 'JwtConfig' manages JWT token configuration, including generating tokens, retrieving authorization headers, and creating refresh token cookies within a Spring Boot application.

classes.name: JwtConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for managing JWT token properties, token creation, and refresh token cookie generation.

methods.name: getAuthorizationHeader
methods.description: Returns the HTTP header name used for authorization, typically 'Authorization'.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token based on the authentication result, secret key, and whether it is a refresh token.

methods.name: createToken
methods.description: Creates a JWT token string with subject, authorities, issued date, expiration date, and signs it with the provided key.

methods.name: getRefreshTokenCookie
methods.description: Creates an HTTP-only, secure cookie containing the refresh token with appropriate max age.
